notes:
The rule is implementable as stated with no guessing, and I found no step of the proof that fails to follow. Steps (a) to (g) checked line by line:
- (a), (b): correct. s - u(s) is -s for s <= t and k - s for s > t, giving each of -t..t once.
- (c): correct. Position j uses band L-j+1 for every j including j = 1, so numbers are a bijection onto t+1..t+kL and each leg strictly decreases.
- (d): correct. The even step uses the previous odd label t+(L-i)k+s (the odd formula at index i-1), which the induction does supply; signs match the stated up, down, up pattern.
- (e): correct. ik - t = t+(i-1)k+1 because k = 2t+1; odd positions give bands floor(L/2)+1..L and even positions give bands 1..floor(L/2).
- (f), (g): correct. K' = K + 2KL + 1 uses t = KL, which holds at every stage.
